fields.description: The submittable transaction DocType to create. Masters, singles and child tables are refused.
fields.label: Target DocType

fields.description: Natural-language rule passed to LlamaCloud classification.
fields.label: Classification Description

fields.description: Comma-separated fieldnames to extract, parent and child. Leave blank to extract the required fields.
fields.label: Included Fields

fields.description: Comma-separated parent fieldnames of the target DocType that together identify a duplicate. Leave blank to skip the duplicate check. Cancelled documents never count as duplicates.
fields.label: Duplicate Key Fields

fields.description: Numeric header field of the target whose extracted value is checked against the total of the line items. Leave blank to skip the check.
fields.label: Reconciliation Field

fields.description: JSON object of default values for each new draft, keyed by fieldname, or by table.fieldname for a child row. For example {"fieldname": "value"}.
fields.label: Default Values

fields.description: Not implemented in v1. Documents are always saved as Draft, and this flag has no effect.
fields.label: Auto Submit
